כותרת_en: SpaceX (SPCX): the court denied xAI's motion to dismiss the air-pollution suit against its data-center power plant
טקסט_en:
Oct 30, 2026: the court decision and the attorneys' announcement | the publication time in Israel time is unknown. The CNBC report published Oct 31, 2026 at 8:56 PM Israel time and updated at 10:12 PM.

The federal court in northern Mississippi denied xAI's motion to dismiss the NAACP organization's suit regarding gas turbines in Southaven that supply power to the Colossus 2 data center. Per CNBC, xAI is currently owned and operated by SpaceX.

Per the announcement of Earthjustice, which represents the plaintiffs, and per CNBC, Judge Debra Brown rejected the claim that the turbines are exempt from a permit requirement because they are mobile. She also rejected the arguments against the plaintiffs' standing to run the proceeding and against the constitutionality of the citizen-suit track under the Clean Air Act.

The meaning is the suit will continue to be heard, not that a final judgment against the company has been given. Earthjustice notes the court has not yet ruled on the request for a temporary restraining order. These sources contain no announcement of a shutdown order, a fine imposed or a halt to data-center activity.

This is a legal risk to the power infrastructure of the AI activity, but no quantified financial or operational impact was verified. The decision is separate from the Justice Department's motion to end the same proceeding being denied earlier in October.

The item was located now; it is not a new November 1 decision.
תקציר_en: The suit continues: what is the risk to the data center's power infrastructure?

ג'סי הסביר שהחברה בוחנת כיצד לחלק את הקצאת השבבים שלה בין מכירה חיצונית לבין שימוש בתוך הענן שלה. לדבריו, מכירה חיצונית מאפשרת הכרה מהירה יותר בהכנסה, בעוד ששימוש בשבב בתוך שירותי הענן עשוי לייצר הכנסה לאורך חמש עד שש שנים. הוא אמר שהאיזון הזה ייבחן כנראה מדי שנה.

טקסט_en:
Not verified against a primary source
Oct 29, 2026 | the company call began at 11:00 PM Israel time; the exact time of the remark is unknown.

Amazon's CEO, Andy Jassy, said on the October 29 company call that it intends to offer Trainium-type AI chips to customers outside AWS in late 2027. The remarks appear in the call transcripts, both in his prepared remarks and in the Q&A session. This is a future target for external chip activity, not an announcement that selling has already begun.

Jassy explained the company is examining how to split its chip allocation between external sales and use inside its cloud. The move may expand the chips' target market beyond customers consuming them through AWS. However, the transcript checked did not give a launch customer name, a price or a committed external-sales volume. There is no confirmation here of an order or of actual shipments.

The item concerns a separate operational move, with no results data or report-to-expectations comparison. It was located now and is not a new November 1 announcement. The call's start time was verified on Amazon's official page; the remark's content is based on secondary transcripts, not on listening to the official recording.

Per an updated Reuters report, Binance today resumed withdrawals of Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB and some USDT and USDC withdrawals, after the suspension following the theft of assets worth about $6.3 billion. CNBC also reports renewed withdrawals on the Bitcoin network and later on the Ethereum network and BNB Smart Chain. This is a phased opening, not a full return of all coins and networks to normal activity.

In a check of Binance's official status page at 12:02 PM Israel time, the ETH, BNB, USDT and USDC rows now showed withdrawal suspension on only some networks, versus the withdrawal suspension shown in the morning check. The fill rate of the affected assets, about 95% per the company and Reuters, is not new data versus the morning update. This is filling using the company's funds and purchasing replacement assets, not recovery of 95% of the stolen money from the attackers. There is no confirmation here of the incident's end or of full withdrawal availability.

Related to the last update sent Nov 1, 2026 at 8:02 AM Israel time, on the 95% fill and a planned opening window of 8:00-11:00 AM.
What is new: a report of withdrawals actually resuming, not just a plan to open, alongside a change on the official status page from suspension to suspension on some networks for several of the main assets.

כותרת_en: Anthropic: Claude limits replicating existing games; no confirmation of a blanket ban on reverse engineering
טקסט_en:
Not verified against a primary source
Oct 30, 2026 | 9:22 PM Israel time - XDA's test publication; a follow-up article on Oct 31, publication time unknown

Anthropic is narrowing the ability to use Claude Code to recreate a specific game of another developer, even if its name is changed. Per a test by the developers' site (XDA), the restriction operated in at least some of the tests on Claude Opus 5.5, but the rollout's scope across all users and models is still unclear.

In the follow-up article, the gaming site (PC Gamer) quotes Eddie Osmani, a technical staff member at Anthropic, explaining the goal is to prevent intellectual-property infringement. Per the quote, creating original games, games in a certain genre and games based on the user's design and assets are supposed to keep working. His original remarks were not verified against a primary source.

The important distinction: there is no basis to determine Claude now bans all reverse engineering, game porting or bug fixing. In XDA's tests, the model agreed to assist with some code-disassembly and platform-adaptation tasks. On the other hand, the hardware site (Tom's Hardware) describes user complaints of refusals also in legitimate development and testing work. These are user reports, not proof all these tasks are blocked or that all are connected to the same change.

PC Gamer
Tom's Hardware

טקסט_en:
Aug 21, 2026 | the original publication time in Israel time is unknown; an official reminder from Oct 23, 2026

The iShares fund manager confirms the SOXX chip ETF will carry out a forward split at a ratio of three units per existing unit. Trading at the split-adjusted price will begin Thursday, November 5. This is a move announced in August that received an official reminder in October, not a new announcement this morning.

The record date is Tuesday, November 3. The split will be carried out after trading ends Wednesday, November 4, and adjusted trading begins the next day.

In a 3-for-1 split the number of units triples and each unit's price is adjusted to about a third, before market moves. The split itself does not create a return or change the holding's total value. Therefore the technical drop in the unit price on the split day must not be read as a roughly two-thirds plunge in the holding's value.
תקציר_en: More units, a lower price: why doesn't the split create a return on its own?

כותרת: Meta (META): בית המשפט בפריז הותיר בתוקף את צווי הביניים בנושא תשלום למו"לים
טקסט:

29.10.2026 | שעת הפרסום המקורית בשעון ישראל אינה ידועה

בית המשפט לערעורים בפריז דחה את ערעורי מטא נגד צעדי ביניים שהטילה רשות התחרות הצרפתית בסכסוך על תשלום עבור שימוש בתוכן עיתונאי. כך עולה מדיווח רויטרס ומהודעת ארגון זכויות המו"לים הצרפתי (DVP), שהוא צד להליך.

הצעדים, שהוטלו ביולי, מחייבים את מטא לחדש משא ומתן עם ארגוני העיתונות, למסור מידע על הכנסות הפלטפורמות ועל השימוש בתוכן המוגן, ולא לפגוע באופן הצגת תוכני העיתונות. לפי רויטרס, בית המשפט אמר ששיטות קביעת התשלום עשויות להוות ניצול לרעה של מעמד דומיננטי. זו אינה הכרעה סופית בהליך העיקרי ואינה הודעה על קנס חדש.

מטא מסרה לרויטרס שהיא מאוכזבת מההחלטה, בוחנת את צעדיה הבאים ותמשיך לקיים את צעדי הביניים ולנהל משא ומתן בתום לב. ארגון המו"לים בירך על ההחלטה; עמדתו אינה מקור בלתי תלוי.

מדובר בהחלטה מ-29 באוקטובר שאותרה כעת דרך כתבת המשך מ-31 באוקטובר, לא בהכרעה חדשה מהיום. זהו הליך צרפתי נפרד מהחלטת אופקום בבריטניה שנשלחה ב-31.10 בשעה 06:03 שעון ישראל, ומחקירת התנאים המסחריים של מטא.

This follows from a Reuters report and from an announcement by the French publishers' rights organization (DVP), which is a party to the proceeding.

The measures, imposed in July, require Meta to renew negotiations with the press organizations, provide information on the platforms' revenues and on the use of protected content, and not harm the way press content is displayed. Per Reuters, the court said the payment-setting methods may constitute abuse of a dominant position. This is not a final ruling in the main proceeding and not an announcement of a new fine.

Meta told Reuters it is disappointed with the decision, is examining its next steps and will continue to comply with the interim measures and negotiate in good faith. The publishers' organization welcomed the decision; its position is not a disinterested source.

This is an October 29 decision located now through an October 31 follow-up article, not a new ruling today. It is a French proceeding separate from the Ofcom decision in Britain sent Oct 31 at 6:03 AM Israel time and from the probe of Meta's commercial terms.

טקסט:

בינאנס פרסמה עדכון רשמי רביעי בעקבות אירוע האבטחה. החברה מסרה שהיא נערכת לחדש את השלב הראשון של שירותי המשיכה היום, 1 בנובמבר, במהלך החלון 08:00-11:00 שעון ישראל. זהו חלון מתוכנן לפתיחה מדורגת, לא אישור שהמשיכות כבר חודשו או שכל השירותים ייפתחו בבת אחת.

נכון לבדיקה בעמוד הסטטוס הרשמי ב-08:02 שעון ישראל, החלון המתוכנן כבר החל, אך טרם אומתה פתיחה מלאה של השלב הראשון. בשורת הביטקוין (BTC) מוצגת השעיית משיכות בחלק מהרשתות; באת'ריום (ETH) ובמספר נכסים אחרים עדיין מוצגת השעיית משיכות. אין בכך אישור שכל משיכות הביטקוין זמינות.

לפי החברה, שיעור מילוי הנכסים שנפגעו הגיע לכ-95%, לעומת 90% בעדכון הקודם. יתרת כ-5% נוגעת למטבעות מחוץ לעשרת הנכסים העיקריים, שלדבריה נזילותם נמוכה יותר ולכן רכישת הכמות החסרה אורכת זמן. מילוי נכסים באמצעות כספי החברה ורכישות בשוק אינו אומר שאותו שיעור מהכסף הגנוב הוחזר מהתוקפים.

בשלב הראשון ייפתחו בהדרגה שילובים נבחרים של מטבעות ורשתות, ובהם ביטקוין ברשת BTC, את'ריום ומטבעות USDT ו-USDC ברשת ETH, וכן BNB ומטבעות יציבים ברשת BSC. הרשימה כוללת רשתות נוספות, אך לא כל מטבע זמין בכל רשת. בינאנס אומרת שכל שילוב ייפתח רק לאחר בדיקות יציבות ואבטחה, ושייתכנו עיכובים או ניסיונות משיכה שייכשלו זמנית בעומס הפתיחה. ההפקדות ממשיכות לפעול כרגיל.

החברה חוזרת על התחייבותה לשאת בכל ההפסדים ועל טענתה שלעשרה נכסים עיקריים יש גיבוי מלא. אלה הצהרות החברה, לא ביקורת חשבונאית עצמאית ולא אישור שכל המשיכות זמינות כעת.

קשור לעדכון האחרון שנשלח ב-1.11.2026 בשעה 00:01 שעון ישראל, על ייחוס הפריצה לצפון קוריאה לפי רויטרס, ולעדכון ההתאוששות שנשלח ב-31.10 בשעה 16:42 על כיסוי 90% מהנכסים.

כותרת_en: Binance: refilled about 95% of the affected assets; a phased resumption of withdrawals is planned today between 8:00-11:00 AM Israel time
טקסט_en:
Nov 1, 2026 | the original announcement's publication time in Israel time is unknown; an Odaily follow-up report: 6:16 AM Israel time

Binance published a fourth official update following the security incident. The company said it is preparing to resume the first stage of withdrawal services today, November 1, during the 8:00-11:00 AM Israel time window. This is a planned window for a phased opening, not confirmation withdrawals have already resumed or that all services will open at once.

As of a check of the official status page at 8:02 AM Israel time, the planned window had already begun, but a full opening of the first stage had not yet been verified. The Bitcoin (BTC) row shows withdrawal suspension on some networks; Ethereum (ETH) and several other assets still show a withdrawal suspension. This is not confirmation that all Bitcoin withdrawals are available.

Per the company, the refill rate of the affected assets reached about 95%, versus 90% in the previous update. The remaining about 5% concerns coins outside the ten main assets, which it says are less liquid, so purchasing the missing quantity takes time. Refilling assets using the company's funds and market purchases does not mean the same share of the stolen money was recovered from the attackers.

In the first stage, selected coin-and-network combinations will open gradually, including Bitcoin on the BTC network, Ethereum and the USDT and USDC coins on the ETH network, and BNB and stablecoins on the BSC network. The list includes additional networks, but not every coin is available on every network. Binance says each combination will open only after stability and security checks, and that there may be delays or withdrawal attempts that temporarily fail under the opening load. Deposits continue to operate as usual.

The company repeats its commitment to bear all the losses and its claim that the ten main assets have full backing. These are the company's statements, not an independent accounting audit and not confirmation that all withdrawals are available now.

Related to the last update sent Nov 1, 2026 at 12:01 AM Israel time, on attributing the breach to North Korea per Reuters, and to the recovery update sent Oct 31 at 4:42 PM on covering 90% of the assets.
What is new: a reported rise to 95% and an explicit hours window for opening the first stage today, instead of a general target for Sunday.
תקציר_en: Per the company, asset coverage rose to 95%; this is not confirmation all withdrawals are open.

כותרת_en: Goldman Sachs research: workers laid off from AI-exposed jobs find it harder to return to work
טקסט_en:
Not verified against a primary source
Oct 29, 2026 | the publication time of the Goldman Sachs research is unknown
The Fortune article: Oct 30, 2026 | 3:09 PM Israel time

Per a Fortune report on Goldman Sachs research published Thursday, October 29, workers who lost AI-exposed jobs since 2025 needed about one additional month on average to find work compared with other laid-off workers. Their chance of remaining unemployed a year later was higher by about 10 percentage points, not 10%.

The gap was larger among those 35 and older: returning to a full-time job took about five weeks longer than for other laid-off workers, versus about three weeks among those under 35. Economist Pierfrancesco Mei wrote the findings are similar in magnitude to the persistent harm observed in previous waves of technological change.

An important caveat: the survey does not ask whether AI caused the layoffs. The researchers identified a group likely to have been harmed using an index combining occupational exposure to AI, the technology's adoption in the industry and the position's elimination. The analysis included more than 15,000 laid-off workers in 2016-2025. This is a research correlation, not proof all these positions were eliminated because of AI or that the whole economy is experiencing such a layoff wave. Goldman notes it is still too early to estimate the full effects.

כותרת_en: Binance: coverage of assets affected in the breach rose to 90%; funding also from the futures insurance fund
טקסט_en:
Oct 31, 2026 | the original announcement's publication time in Israel time is unverified; the TechFlow report published at 4:31 PM Israel time

Binance published a third recovery update following the breach. The company says the coverage rate in those affected digital assets rose from about 80% to 90%, and that the ten coins BTC, ETH, USDT, BNB, SOL, USDC, XRP, USD1, RLUSD and ZEC are now fully backed. The remaining 10% includes less liquid coins the company continues to purchase in the market and in over-the-counter trading.

Related to the update sent yesterday at 5:23 PM on allocating $6.34 billion, and to the updates at 8:03 PM and 10:02 PM on the proof of reserves and resumption of withdrawals. What is new: reported progress in purchasing the replacement assets, use of part of the futures insurance fund, and details of the cryptographic proof. This is not recovery of 90% of the money from the attackers: it is coverage using Binance's funding sources, per the company.

Alongside company funds, Binance is allocating part of the SAFU protection fund and transferring part of the futures insurance fund. According to it, the insurance fund balance remains above the threshold required under its risk management. The partial use of SAFU is expected within 24 hours of the announcement, and the company commits to restoring its size to about $1 billion. These are the company's statements, not independent verification of the funds' state.

Binance says a new snapshot of the balances, taken Oct 31 at 2:00 AM Israel time, was already uploaded to the proof-of-reserves site. Creating the full zero-knowledge proof is expected, per the announcement, by Tuesday, November 3 UTC, versus the Monday, November 2 target given in the previous update. This is an estimated date, not an announcement the proof is already complete. A snapshot and coverage data are not equivalent to a full financial audit, and the full proof was not verified here.

The company continues to aim for resuming withdrawals Sunday, November 1, and promises to publish details when confirmed. The update contains no announcement that withdrawals have already resumed or a final opening time.

Oct 19, 2026 | 12:12 PM Israel time - the article's publication on InsideEVs

Per InsideEVs, a 2019 electric Chevrolet Bolt arrived at the Out of Spec Renew garage after accumulating about 471,000 miles, about 758,000 kilometers. A cell imbalance in two modules in the battery prevented it from entering drive mode.

The article was published October 19; this is not a new company announcement today.

קשור לעדכון שנשלח ב-15:21 על בחינת מסר ואנס והאמירה החיובית בנוגע לדיאלוג, ולעדכון ב-05:21 על טיוטת המתווכים. מה חדש: פרטי המשלחת והצעות הגרעין מיוחסים כעת ישירות לשר החוץ בכתבה המורחבת, ולא רק למקורות דיפלומטיים. גם האמירה שאין תוכנית נוכחית לפגישות עם גורמים אמריקאיים מופיעה כעת במקור עצמו, אחרי שנמסרה בעדכון הקודם על סמך דיווח משני.

אין כאן הודעה על חידוש משא ומתן ישיר או על הסכם. לדברי עראקצ'י, ההחלטה אם השיחות יהיו ישירות או עקיפות תתקבל רק אחרי שוושינגטון תסכים לתנאים האיראניים.

כותרת_en: FINRA sets a combined reporting test ahead of expanding stock trading to 23 hours a day
טקסט_en:
Oct 30, 2026 | the publication time in Israel time is unknown

FINRA announced the industry test on November 6-7 will also check the link between trade reports at the TRF reporting facilities and the exchanges and the events reported to the CAT trade-tracking system. According to it, this will be the only opportunity to test this link with CAT support before the planned December 6 implementation. There will be additional readiness tests on November 20 and December 4, but not the same supported link test.

Related to the update sent Oct 30 at 11:03 PM on Nasdaq's opening rules ahead of night trading. What is new: FINRA's announcement now details the reporting- and tracking-infrastructure test, not a new announcement of the trading start date. The window for submitting test events to CAT will end Saturday, Nov 7, at 8:00 AM New York, that is 3:00 PM in Israel.

Per the existing plan, FINRA's TRF trade-reporting systems will operate from Sunday 9:00 PM to Friday 8:00 PM New York time, with a one-hour daily pause Monday to Thursday. In December the start will be Monday at 4:00 AM in Israel, and the pauses will be 3:00-4:00 AM the next day. The separate ADF reporting system is not extending its hours in this change.

This is an operational preparation stage, not an announcement the test already succeeded or that every broker will allow every client around-the-clock trading. The announcement was published October 30.

The update concerns Exxon's activity in the UAE. It does not verify that all the country's output or exports returned to routine. This section gave no numeric output volume or exact reference date for comparison.

לפי הסוכנות, המינוף המתואם של מטא עלול לעבור כבר ב-2027 את סף ה-1.0 שהיא מציינת ביחס לדירוג הנוכחי. הסוכנות מייחסת חלק מרכזי בעלייה הצפויה להתחייבויות לחכירת מרכזי נתונים, ולא רק להנפקת חוב. היא גם חוששת שהתזרים התפעולי החופשי יישאר שלילי מעבר ל-2028, אם ההוצאות יישארו גבוהות וההכנסות מההשקעות ב-AI יתעכבו.

אלה הערכות של סוכנות הדירוג, לא תחזית חדשה שפרסמה הנהלת מטא. דובר מטא אמר לרויטרס שהחברה חולקת על ההערכה לגבי יכולתה להפיק הכנסות מ-AI, ורואה הזדמנויות מוצריות ועסקיות שתומכות בפרופיל האשראי שלה.

אין בסיס להציג אותה כאירוע חדש מהבוקר או לייחס לה בדיעבד את הירידות בשוק.

כותרת_en: Meta (META): S&P changed the credit-rating outlook to negative; the AA- rating is unchanged
טקסט_en:
Oct 30, 2026 | the original publication time in Israel time is unknown

The rating agency S&P Global Ratings changed Meta's credit-rating outlook from stable to negative, due to uncertainty about AI infrastructure spending and free operating cash flow. The rating itself was affirmed: this is a warning of a risk of a future downgrade, not a downgrade already carried out.

Per the agency, Meta's adjusted leverage could pass the 1.0 threshold it notes relative to the current rating as early as 2027. The agency attributes a central part of the expected rise to data-center lease commitments, not only to debt issuance. It is also concerned free operating cash flow will remain negative beyond 2028, if spending stays high and revenue from the AI investments is delayed.

These are the rating agency's estimates, not a new forecast Meta's management published. A Meta spokesman told Reuters the company disagrees with the assessment of its ability to generate AI revenue, and sees product and business opportunities that support its credit profile.

There is no basis to present it as a new event from this morning or to attribute the market declines to it retroactively.

Per Reuters, Finland's police announced an investigation was opened on suspicion of environmental-law violations at Google's planned data-center site in Muhos. The investigation concerns among other things drainage and water-management work carried out by the subsidiary Tuike Finland before the required environmental checks were completed.

Related to the update sent Oct 12 at 8:28 AM on the regulator's instruction to halt preparation works at two sites. What is new: a police criminal investigation, not a new halt order or a cancellation of the project.

The investigator quoted in Reuters said it will be examined whether the activity violated the Water Act and caused environmental damage. According to him, a conviction could lead to a fine for the company. No indictment, conviction or fine already imposed was reported, and he did not say whether private individuals may be suspects.

Google told Reuters it will cooperate with the investigation and continue acting to meet requirements. Per the report, the police plan an update in December and the investigation is expected to continue into 2027. The decision on permits to resume the works remains with the environmental regulator; no approved resumption date was published.

The site is part of Google's investment plan in Finland, and not the whole plan is under investigation or cancelled. No new quantified impact on Alphabet's forecast was published.

Oct 29, 2026 | 12:00 PM Israel time - the company announcement's distribution time

Broadridge, traded in New York under the symbol BR, announced Kalshi's event contracts are available for trading through the trading interfaces and programming interfaces of CQG, which it owns. The meaning is that eligible users can combine contracts on event outcomes in a trading environment also used for futures, options and stocks, instead of working in a separate system.

Per the company, the connection includes access to trading and market data for brokers and clearing members. Later, access is meant to expand also to NYFIX network participants through the CQG connection. Access is subject to eligibility and rules in each jurisdiction. No transaction amount, expected revenues or a binding date for activating access through NYFIX were given. This is a distribution and infrastructure expansion for trading event contracts, not a new regulatory approval and not a change in stock-exchange trading hours.

The announcement was published October 29 and was located in the scan now; it is not a new launch from last night.

כותרת_en: Oil movement in Hormuz continues despite the many attacks, but shipping costs soared, per CNBC
טקסט_en:
The providers' data were not verified against the primary sources
Oct 30, 2026 | 7:21 PM Israel time - the original publication time on CNBC

Related to the update sent today at 2:05 PM on a tanker attack, and to the 9:21 PM update on a report of an incident south of Lavan Island. What is new: oil-flow and shipping-cost data, not a report of another attack.

Per Kpler data cited by CNBC, oil exports through Hormuz in October averaged almost 11.1 million barrels a day, about 2% less than September, despite the escalation. However, in the week ending Wednesday the pace fell to 7.3 million barrels a day, more than 40% below the pre-war level. A monthly average does not show the flow is steady at month's end.

Per an analyst at the shipbroker Braemar quoted in the article, the cost of chartering a supertanker for a route from Oman's Gulf to Asia rose from about $249,000 a day in early September to more than $900,000 a day in the first week of October. The shipping cost per barrel on the same route rose, according to her, from about $6.50 to about $21. These are estimates for the periods and route specified in the article, not a current price quote for every oil shipment.

The article describes use of a system of transfers between tankers inside and outside the Gulf, which per the sources helps preserve exports but requires more ships and makes shipping more expensive. These are provider data and industry sources via CNBC; the original data themselves were not checked here. Today's publication was located in the scan now, and is not presented as a development of the last few minutes.

כותרת_en: Cboe (CBOE) adds instructions separating night trading, regular trading and the closing session in options
טקסט_en:
Oct 7, 2026 - the SEC notice date | the publication time in Israel time is unknown

Per an official SEC document, Cboe added GTH Only and GTH and RTH Only instructions, which allow limiting an options order to night trading only, or to night trading and regular trading without it continuing to the Curb closing session. Their purpose is to allow explicit control over the sessions in which an order can execute.

The amendment also allows accepting orders for the queue earlier ahead of the trading open, clarifies the Curb session in eligible products will last 15 minutes after the close on a shortened trading day, and applies the relevant market makers' opening-quote obligation in every session they are assigned to.

The amendment was filed September 25. The SEC waived the regular waiting period and determined it is effective from the filing date; the specific implementation hours are set in exchange notices. This is not confirmation every option is available in night trading, and there is no new launch of trading hours today here.

The earlier document was located now following an article published today. It is separate from the updates already sent on the trading-hours expansion and Cboe's new contract products.

כותרת_en: Nasdaq defines how trading will open in new investment products under night trading
טקסט_en:
Oct 13, 2026 - the SEC notice date | the publication time in Israel time is unknown

Related to the update sent Oct 21 at 5:54 PM on Nasdaq's planned trading expansion. What is new: rules for opening trading on the first day of new exchange-traded products (ETPs), not an additional change to the launch date.

Per the official document, a new ETP listed on Nasdaq whose issuer did not choose the dedicated Initial ETP Open track will not begin trading automatically at the night-session open. Trading in it will halt at 9:00 PM New York time the day before, and will open in the Nasdaq Halt Cross mechanism no earlier than 4:00 AM on the trading day. Under the December schedule these are 4:00 AM and 11:00 AM Israel time, respectively.

Nasdaq notes it usually expects an opening at 9:00 AM New York, that is 4:00 PM in Israel. This is not a rule that every new product will open exactly at that time. The rule applies to a subset of new products, not to all existing ETFs and not to all stocks.

The amendment was filed October 1, and its implementation is planned with the start of trading in the 23-hours-a-day, five-days-a-week format. The launch target the exchange published is the evening of December 6 in the US, that is December 7 at 4:00 AM in Israel, subject to the required completions. This is an earlier document located now following today's article, not a new decision from this evening.

Sources: the SEC; Nasdaq

כותרת_en: US derivatives-regulator chairman: the Binance breach strengthens the need for a registration track for crypto exchanges
טקסט_en:
The interview details were not verified against a full transcript of the primary source; the regulatory proceeding was checked against the agency
Oct 30, 2026 | 7:32 PM Israel time: Stocktwits' publication via Yahoo; the original interview time was not verified

Related to the last update at 10:02 PM on the reported target for starting the resumption of withdrawals at Binance. What is new: the chairman of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC), Michael Selig, links the event to a federal track he wants to offer crypto exchanges, and says the agency will assist law enforcement in the investigation.

Per a Stocktwits report on the CNBC interview, Selig said the agency wants to let exchanges register with it and be subject to cybersecurity measures similar to those in American markets. He pointed to proposals published earlier this month, and did not announce that new rules took effect following the breach.

The agency's official October 5 announcement contains an early call for public comments on a possible framework for retail crypto transactions and for registering crypto markets. This is a proceeding toward forming rules, not a promise Binance has registered or that the track is already available to every exchange.

Selig also said blockchain records can help track the money. This is an assessment of the investigative capability, not confirmation specific money was already located or recovered. It is not an official attribution of the attack to North Korea.

כותרת_en: Britain opened an investigation into Meta's (META) commercial terms
טקסט_en:
Oct 30, 2026 | the publication time in Israel time is unknown

Britain's Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) opened an investigation to examine a concern that Meta's commercial terms abusively exploit a dominant position and harm publishers, advertisers and content businesses.

Per the authority, the terms may allow Meta to collect content from businesses' and publishers' sites that use its services, and use it to develop and operate products and services, including AI capabilities, without them being given a choice whether and how the content will be used. The authority will examine whether Meta holds a dominant position in the relevant UK market, and whether the terms constitute its abuse under competition law.

What is new: an official competition investigation was opened. Per the authority, Meta already announced October 28 a pause in deploying the terms for consultations with industry bodies, after the implementation was postponed from October 30 to November 20. It must not be inferred the terms will take effect November 20 despite the pause.

This is the start of an investigation, not a determination that Meta violated the law, and no fine was imposed in the announcement. Separately, the authority requests information on the Meta One business subscription and on concerns over posting external links without payment; this issue is not part of the opened investigation, and no decision was made to open a formal proceeding on it.

The US Securities and Exchange Commission's enforcement chief, David Woodcock, said in an interview with Reuters that the agency is examining AI companies' disclosure to investors. According to him, the emphasis is on accurate reporting of material information, so investors understand the risks they are exposed to.

The remarks come against the background of market concern over the scale of AI spending and circular deals between companies in the industry. Woodcock said the agency does not seek to stand in the way of technological innovation, but when the required disclosure is not given, "enforcement will be present".

What is new: this is an explicit reference by the enforcement chief to AI companies' disclosure, not only the agency's general priorities for examinations next year. The report named no companies under investigation, announced no specific enforcement case and did not claim the agency determined a violation occurred. These remarks must not be attributed the stock declines without additional evidence.

Woodcock also warned AI makes creating large-scale fraud easier and cheaper, and called on brokers and other companies to protect retail investors.

Dallas Fed president Lorie Logan said in a speech at Davidson College that per the current forecast at least two more rate hikes of 0.25 percentage points each are needed. After that, in her view, it would be sensible to pause and examine economic and financial developments before deciding on further steps.

Logan estimates the current rate range is at least half a percentage point below the level that would create mild restraint and start returning the inflation trend to target. According to her, growth and consumption are strong, the labor market is balanced and perhaps even tightening slightly, and price pressures are broad beyond the temporary effects of tariffs and energy.

What is new: Logan explains why she voted this week to leave the rate unchanged, and in parallel details a target of at least two more hikes. She emphasizes that skipping a hike at one meeting does not change the target. This is her personal position, not a Fed commitment to a number of hikes or their dates; she may change it if the forecast and risks change.

Related to the breach updates sent today at 2:05 PM, 3:41 PM and 4:44 PM. This is not an additional breach.

What is new: per the BBC, the FBI said it is aware of the incident and working with partners in the public and private sectors to understand its scope, assess implications and coordinate investigative steps. The quoted statement does not attribute the attack to North Korea and does not announce arrests or the investigation's end.

Separately, per The Block and Reuters, Binance said it allocated more than $6.34 billion of company funds to cover the incident. About $5 billion is already held, according to it, in the same digital assets that were stolen, and it is purchasing the remainder in the market and through over-the-counter (OTC) channels. The company warned limited liquidity and settlement times may extend the process. This allocation detail was not included in the previous update, which reported the general commitment to cover losses.

The sum does not include the roughly $3 billion that was frozen per the company. Freezing is not recovering the money. An allocation and a statement of holdings are not independent confirmation that coverage of all assets is already complete: per an additional Cointelegraph report, Binance did not disclose the wallet addresses, and promised the holdings will appear in the next proof-of-reserves report. The CertiK company said it needs additional details for independent verification.

The update was checked in secondary reports. Binance's original post was opened, but the full sums breakdown and the FBI's original statement were not verified directly. There is no confirmation here that withdrawals resumed or a verified commitment to their return date.

לפי בי־בי־סי ודקריפט, בינאנס מסרה שבחקירה המאוחרת יותר נמצאו "נקודות חדירה נוספות". מנכ"ל־שותף ריצ'רד טנג אמר שהתוקף לא הסתפק בהרשאות של מהנדס אחד, ושלא מדובר בפעולה יחידה ופשוטה אלא בתהליך תקיפה מורכב יותר. לדבריו, החקירה לא ייחסה אחריות לאדם מסוים.

הדיווחים אינם מפרטים מה היו נקודות החדירה הנוספות או מאשרים שהבדיקה הסתיימה. אין להסיק מכך שמפתחות הארנקים דלפו, שהייתה פריצה חדשה או שהחקירה אישרה את זהות האחראים.

זהו מידע מהבוקר שאותר רק כעת בבדיקת ההשלמה, לא הודעה חדשה מהדקות האחרונות. אין בעדכון הזה אישור שמשיכות הכספים חזרו לפעול או התחייבות מאומתת למועד חזרתן.

דיווח רויטרס המעודכן ביאהו: 30.10.2026, 10:07 שעון ישראל

קשור לעדכון שנשלח היום ב־16:26 על מעבדות בדיקה. מה חדש: הליך נפרד שנוגע לגישה למספרי טלפון אמריקאיים, ולא לכללים שאומצו לגבי מעבדות.

ה־FCC פרסם טיוטה לחיזוק הדרישות מספקי טלפוניה באינטרנט המבקשים לקבל מספרי טלפון אמריקאיים ישירות. הטיוטה כוללת הצהרות ובדיקות ביטחון לאומי לגבי חברות ברשימת הסיכון של הרשות, ציוד ושירותים מכוסים וחברות שרישיונות התקשורת שלהן נשללו או נדחו מטעמי ביטחון.

לפי רויטרס, המהלך נועד למנוע מצ'יינה מובייל, צ'יינה טלקום וצ'יינה יוניקום וספקים נוספים גישה ישירה למספרים. גישה ישירה יכולה להוזיל את העלויות לספקי טלפוניה באינטרנט. הישיבה שבה צפויה הרשות לשקול את ההצעה מתוכננת ל־19 בנובמבר.

דובר משרד החוץ הסיני הביע התנגדות ואמר שסין תנקוט צעדים נחוצים להגנת זכויותיה, לפי רויטרס. זו עמדה ואזהרה, לא הודעה על סנקציות חדשות שכבר בוצעו.

הרשות מבהירה בעמוד הטיוטה שלא מדובר בפעולה סופית שאומצה, ושנוסח ההחלטה עשוי להשתנות. אין כאן הודעה על ניתוק שכבר בוצע או על איסור חדש שנכנס היום לתוקף.

כותרת_en: The US advances limits on Chinese telecom companies' direct access to American phone numbers
טקסט_en:
This is a proposal ahead of a vote, not a ban already adopted
The FCC draft: Oct 29, 2026, the original publication time in Israel time is unknown
The updated Reuters report in Yahoo: Oct 30, 2026, 10:07 AM Israel time

Related to the update sent today at 4:26 PM on testing laboratories. What is new: a separate proceeding concerning access to American phone numbers, not the rules adopted regarding laboratories.

The FCC published a draft to strengthen requirements on internet telephony providers seeking to receive American phone numbers directly. The draft includes declarations and national-security checks regarding companies on the agency's risk list, covered equipment and services, and companies whose communications licenses were revoked or denied on security grounds.

Per Reuters, the move aims to deny China Mobile, China Telecom and China Unicom and additional providers direct access to the numbers. Direct access can lower costs for internet telephony providers. The meeting at which the agency is expected to consider the proposal is planned for November 19.

A Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman expressed opposition and said China will take necessary steps to defend its rights, per Reuters. This is a position and a warning, not an announcement of new sanctions already carried out.

The agency clarifies on the draft page this is not a final adopted action, and the decision's wording may change. There is no announcement here of a disconnection already carried out or a new ban taking effect today.

כותרת: Cboe (CBOE) מתכננת הוראת תזמון חדשה לפקודות מניה בבורסת BYX
טקסט:
30.10.2026: פרסום ההודעה ברשומות הפדרליות | שעת הפרסום בשעון ישראל אינה ידועה
הבקשה הוגשה ב־15.10; הודעת ה־SEC מתוארכת ל־27.10.

קשור לעדכון מ־28.10 ב־09:09 על יעד המסחר הלילי בבורסת EDGX. מה חדש: שינוי נפרד בטיפול בפקודות בבורסת BYX, ולא הארכת שעות המסחר בה.

לפי המסמך הרשמי, סיבו מתכננת להוסיף לפקודות בבורסת BYX הוראת "שעת התחלה" (Start Time). ההוראה תאפשר לקבוע מראש מתי פקודה שהוזנה לפני המסחר הרגיל תהפוך לזמינה לביצוע, במרווחים של חצי שעה.

החלון השימושי יהיה מ־07:00 עד 09:00 שעון ניו יורק. לפי מועד היישום המתוכנן, 7.12.2026, מדובר ב־14:00 עד 16:00 שעון ישראל, לפני פתיחת המסחר הרגיל ב־16:30. אין בכך הבטחה שהפקודה תתבצע בזמן שנבחר, אלא רק שתהיה זכאית לביצוע לפי תנאיה.

היישום מתוכנן ליום שני, 7 בדצמבר, בתיאום עם הוראה דומה ב־EDGX. המסמך פורסם כהודעה על הגשת שינוי כללים בעל תחולה מיידית; מועד היישום הוא יעד הבורסה, לא הודעה שהאפשרות זמינה כבר היום. ל־BYX אין במסמך סשן מסחר לילי, ואין להסיק מהשינוי שכל בורסות סיבו עוברות למסחר של 23 שעות.

כותרת_en: Cboe (CBOE) plans a new timing instruction for stock orders on the BYX exchange
טקסט_en:
Oct 30, 2026: the notice's publication in the Federal Register | the publication time in Israel time is unknown
The request was filed Oct 15; the SEC notice is dated Oct 27.

Related to the Oct 28 update at 9:09 AM on the night-trading target at the EDGX exchange. What is new: a separate change in order handling on the BYX exchange, not an extension of its trading hours.

Per the official document, Cboe plans to add a "Start Time" instruction to orders on the BYX exchange. The instruction will allow setting in advance when an order entered before regular trading becomes eligible for execution, in half-hour intervals.

The usable window will be 7:00 AM to 9:00 AM New York time. Per the planned implementation date, Dec 7, 2026, that is 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM Israel time, before the regular trading open at 4:30 PM. This is no promise the order will execute at the chosen time, only that it will be eligible for execution per its terms.

Implementation is planned for Monday, December 7, in coordination with a similar instruction on EDGX. The document was published as a notice of an immediately effective rule-change filing; the implementation date is the exchange's target, not an announcement the option is available already today. BYX has no night trading session in the document, and it must not be inferred from the change that all Cboe exchanges are moving to 23-hour trading.

הדיווח מבוסס על שני גורמים אמריקאיים שלא זוהו בשמם; אין אישור רשמי לתוכן התדרוך
דיווח מהלילה שבין 29 ל־30 באוקטובר 2026 | שעת הפרסום המקורית בשעון ישראל אינה מאומתת

קשור לעדכון מ־30.10 ב־14:05 על תקיפת מכלית בהורמוז, ולעדכון מ־28.10 ב־14:03 על ההצעות המדיניות לפתיחת המצר והתיווך האזורי. מה חדש: פרטי תדרוך מדווח בבית הלבן על המצור והלחץ הכלכלי, לא דיווח על תקיפה נוספת או על הסכם שהתקבל.

לפי שני גורמים אמריקאיים שמצטט אקסיוס, האדמירל בראד קופר תדרך ביום חמישי את טראמפ על מצב המלחמה עם איראן, בדגש על המצור הימי המתמשך. לפי הדיווח, טראמפ ביקש לשמוע אם המצור פועל כפי שנועד.

לפי אותם גורמים, קופר עדכן גם על הפעילות להכוונת מכליות מחוץ למצר הורמוז לשוקי האנרגיה ועל הלחץ הכלכלי שהצבא מפעיל בשיתוף משרד האוצר. בכירי הממשל השתתפו בתדרוך. הבית הלבן ופיקוד המרכז סירבו להגיב; אקסיוס מציין שהג'ורנל דיווח ראשון על עצם הפגישה.

אין בדיווח אישור להסכם מדיני, להחלטה חדשה לפתוח בתקיפות או למועד תקיפה שנקבע. אין גם בסיס לייחס את תקיפת המכלית שנשלחה קודם לאיראן על סמך התדרוך הזה.

זהו עדכון מאוחר על דיווח מקורי מהלילה הקודם, לא אירוע חדש מהדקות האחרונות. הפצתו היום בפייננשל ג'וס אינה מועד הפרסום המקורי. נתוני העמוד סותרים זה את זה לגבי שעת הפרסום.

כותרת_en: Axios: the US Central Command chief briefed Trump on the blockade of Iran
טקסט_en:
The report is based on two American officials not identified by name; there is no official confirmation of the briefing's content
An overnight report between October 29 and 30, 2026 | the original publication time in Israel time is unverified

Related to the Oct 30 update at 2:05 PM on a tanker attack in Hormuz, and to the Oct 28 update at 2:03 PM on the political proposals for opening the strait and the regional mediation. What is new: details of a reported White House briefing on the blockade and economic pressure, not a report of another attack or an agreement reached.

Per two American officials Axios cites, Admiral Brad Cooper briefed Trump on Thursday on the state of the war with Iran, emphasizing the ongoing naval blockade. Per the report, Trump asked to hear whether the blockade is working as intended.

Per the same officials, Cooper also updated on the activity of directing tankers outside the Strait of Hormuz to energy markets and on the economic pressure the military applies together with the Treasury Department. Administration officials participated in the briefing. The White House and Central Command declined to comment; Axios notes the Journal first reported the meeting's very existence.

The report contains no confirmation of a political agreement, a new decision to open strikes or a set strike date. There is also no basis to attribute the tanker attack sent earlier to Iran based on this briefing.

This is a late update on an original report from the previous night, not a new event of the last few minutes. Its distribution today on Financial Juice is not the original publication time. The page data contradict each other on the publication time.

כותרת: סין מזהירה מצעדי נגד נוספים בעקבות מגבלות ה־FCC על מעבדות בדיקה
טקסט:
תגובת סין נבדקה בדיווחים משניים המצטטים את משרד המסחר; ההודעה המקורית של המשרד לא אותרה
30.10.2026 | שעת הפרסום המקורית בשעון ישראל אינה מאומתת

לפי דיווחי העיתונות בסין, משרד המסחר הסיני קרא לארצות הברית לבטל את המגבלות החדשות על מעבדות בדיקה וגופי הסמכה במדינות שאין להן הסכם הכרה הדדי עם ארה"ב. המשרד הזהיר שאם ארה"ב תתמיד במהלך, סין תנקוט צעדים נחוצים נוספים להגנת זכויותיה.

זו אזהרה מותנית, לא הודעה על סנקציות סיניות חדשות שכבר נכנסו לתוקף. האזכור בתגובה של צעדי נגד קודמים אינו הופך אותם לצעדים שהוכרזו היום.

בהודעה רשמית מ־29.10 מאשר ה־FCC שאימץ כללים סופיים, ולא רק הצעה, המגבילים את ההכרה במעבדות לארה"ב ולמדינות המעניקות הכרה הדדית למעבדות אמריקאיות. לפי ההודעה, החל מ־1 בדצמבר 2028, פעילויות הבדיקה, ההסמכה והאקרדיטציה הרלוונטיות יצטרכו להתבצע בארה"ב או בכלכלה בעלת הסדר הדדי. אין כאן איסור שנכנס לתוקף היום; מועד זה מסיים את תקופת המעבר.

מה חדש: הכללים האמריקאיים שאומצו ב־29.10 ותגובת האזהרה הסינית המדווחת מ־30.10. הם נוגעים למקום שבו חברות אלקטרוניקה יוכלו לבצע בדיקות ואישורים למוצרים המיועדים לשוק האמריקאי.

כותרת_en: China warns of additional countermeasures following the FCC's limits on testing laboratories
טקסט_en:
China's response was checked in secondary reports citing the Commerce Ministry; the ministry's original announcement was not located
Oct 30, 2026 | the original publication time in Israel time is unverified

Per Chinese press reports, China's Commerce Ministry called on the United States to cancel the new limits on testing laboratories and certification bodies in countries without a mutual-recognition agreement with the US. The ministry warned that if the US insists on the move, China will take additional necessary steps to defend its rights.

This is a conditional warning, not an announcement of new Chinese sanctions already in force. The response's mention of previous countermeasures does not make them steps announced today.

In an official October 29 announcement the FCC confirms it adopted final rules, not only a proposal, limiting recognition of laboratories to the US and to countries granting mutual recognition to American laboratories. Per the announcement, starting December 1, 2028, the relevant testing, certification and accreditation activities will have to be performed in the US or in an economy with a mutual arrangement. There is no ban taking effect today here; this date ends the transition period.

What is new: the American rules adopted October 29 and China's reported warning response from October 30. They concern where electronics companies will be able to perform tests and certifications for products meant for the American market.

The compensation demand was not verified against an official announcement from the companies
October 28, 2026. The publication time in Israel time is unknown

Per the L'Informe site, Orange France intends to demand compensation from Nokia following a cellular-network outage on October 21 that harmed millions of customers. Orange France's CEO attributed the outage to a software bug in Nokia equipment. This is attribution by the customer, not an independent determination of responsibility.

A follow-up report by the Data Center Dynamics site, published October 29, notes the compensation may be made through discounts on network equipment, not necessarily in a cash payment. No compensation agreement or verified amount was published, and there is no confirmation here Nokia agreed to pay.

For Nokia this is a commercial issue with a customer, but without an amount or agreement the financial impact cannot be quantified now. The reports presented contain no basis to determine the story is the driver of the stock move today.

כותרת_en: Russia is preparing to extend the diesel export limits through the end of January, with exceptions
טקסט_en:
The decree has not yet been verified against an official government publication
October 30, 2026. The publication time in Israel time is unknown

Russia's deputy prime minister, Alexander Novak, told the Interfax agency the government is preparing a decree extending the ban on diesel exports through the end of January 2027, while keeping exceptions for shipments to the world market. According to him, the planned export volume under the exceptions in November is about 2.15 million tonnes, versus 510,000 tonnes in October.

This is a report of a decree being prepared, not confirmation the decree was already published and took effect. It is also not a full halt of diesel exports: the planned exceptions allow shipments to continue. Per Interfax, the existing ban on producers is due to expire October 31, while the limit on non-producers already continues through the end of January.

For the global energy market, the difference between the restriction's duration and actual export volume matters: an extension through January does not say the whole quantity will disappear from the market, especially given the exceptions Novak pointed to.

כותרת_en: CME Group (CME): the derivatives exchange plans gasoline contracts in windows of about ten days
טקסט_en:
October 28, 2026. The announcement's publication time in Israel time is unknown

The exchange group (CME) announced the listing of three new futures contracts on the New York commodities exchange (NYMEX). The trading open is planned for November 23 at 1:00 AM Israel time. The launch is still subject to completing the regulatory review procedures, and is not final confirmation of trading starting.

The contracts will allow exposure to gasoline prices and price spreads in short windows within the month: the 1st-10th, the 11th-20th and the 21st through month's end. The products include New York Harbor gasoline (RBOB), Gulf Coast gasoline (CBOB), and the price spread between Gulf Coast gasoline and New York gasoline. Each contract represents 42,000 gallons and will be settled in cash, without physical delivery of the fuel.

The novelty is splitting the pricing period into short windows within the month. The contracts will be available for electronic trading and clearing through the exchange's systems (Globex and ClearPort).

The private company plans to start shipments and scale production to high volume in early 2027. Co-packaged optics (CPO) products are planned to arrive in late 2028 or early 2029. These are timetables the CEO presents, not shipments already completed.

According to him, the company completed five co-packaged optics designs for customers this year, and is working on two designs of an optical interposer. The company said in the past it works with NVIDIA and Qualcomm, but the article is not an announcement of a new contract with them.

The industry meaning: even with progress in designing the optical connections for AI infrastructure, scaling shipment volume depends on component availability and production capacity.

טקסט:
מועד תחילת האירוע לפי חברת החקירות: 29 באוקטובר 2026, 22:05 שעון ישראל

בינאנס מעריכה את היקף האירוע בכ־6.3 מיליארד דולר. לדבריה, נכסים בהיקף כ־3 מיליארד דולר הוקפאו, והיא תכסה את כל ההפסדים באמצעות קרן הביטחון שלה (SAFU) וכספי החברה. הקפאה אינה החזרת הכסף, והתחייבות לכיסוי אינה אישור שההחזרים כבר בוצעו.

בעדכון הרשמי שנבדק כעת, החברה מדווחת על השעיה זמנית של משיכות לצורך בדיקות אבטחה. ההפקדות לא נפגעו וממשיכות כרגיל, לפי הבהרה מפורשת בעדכון. זה המצב שהחברה מתארת בהודעה, לא אישור תפעולי בזמן אמת שלא פורסם שינוי נוסף.

לפי חברת חקירות הבלוקצ'יין (TRM Labs), רוב ההעברות התרחשו בתוך כ־20 דקות. החברה מייחסת את המתקפה בביטחון גבוה לקבוצה המקושרת לצפון קוריאה (TraderTraitor). זה ייחוס של חברת חקירות, לא קביעה פומבית של הבולשת האמריקאית לגבי האירוע הזה.

טקסט_en:
The incident's start time per the investigations company: October 29, 2026, 10:05 PM Israel time
Binance's announcement: October 30, 2026. The publication time in Israel time is unknown

Binance estimates the incident's scope at about $6.3 billion. According to it, assets of about $3 billion in scope were frozen, and it will cover all the losses through its insurance fund (SAFU) and company funds. Freezing is not returning the money, and a commitment to cover is not confirmation the refunds were already made.

In the official update checked now, the company reports a temporary suspension of withdrawals for security checks. Deposits were not harmed and continue as usual, per an explicit clarification in the update. This is the state the company describes in the announcement, not real-time operational confirmation that no additional change was published.

Per the blockchain investigations company (TRM Labs), most of the transfers occurred within about 20 minutes. The company attributes the attack with high confidence to the group linked to North Korea (TraderTraitor). This is an investigations company's attribution, not a public determination by the FBI regarding this incident.

כותרת_en: From the "technology and high-tech news" channel: Reddit (RDDT) is examining expanding a login requirement
טקסט_en:
The channel's text; the scope is qualified in the clarification below
October 30, 2026, 9:34:58 AM Israel time

Reddit CEO Steve Huffman announces: browsing the site will require logging in to an account
The Reddit forum network will start requiring users to log in to an account to view its content, a move ending about two decades of open access. Per the company's CEO Steve Huffman, the move is meant to protect the data repository from bot scrapes and improve advertising and monetization performance. The requirement will be examined first in selected markets outside the US in the coming months, and no timetable has been set for a full global launch.

My clarification: per the CEO's Axios interview, this is a planned experiment outside the US, not a blanket block already in effect. The home page and links from search or sharing are meant to remain accessible even without logging in; the final boundaries are still being set.

לפי החברה, הבקשה מצטרפת ליותר מ־50 רישיונות שהיא מחזיקה בארה"ב, באירופה ובאסיה, ובהם רישומי ברוקר־דילר וסוחר סוואפים בארה"ב, רישיון בבריטניה ולאחרונה גם רישיונות לנכסים דיגיטליים ולהעברת כספים בניו יורק. המשמעות בשלב זה היא ניסיון להרחיב את המסגרת הרגולטורית, לא אישור שכבר התקבל או תחילת פעילות של הבנק.

כותרת_en: Galaxy Digital (GLXY) filed a request to establish a national trust bank in the US
טקסט_en:
Oct 29, 2026, 1:00 PM Israel time - the source's publication

Galaxy Digital announced it filed with the US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) a request to establish a national trust bank in New York, under the name Galaxy National Bank. The request was filed only and has not yet been approved.

If approved, the bank will allow the company to provide custody, trading and staking services in digital assets, alongside trust investment-advisory services, under a single federal oversight framework for clients across the US. Per founder and CEO Mike Novogratz, the move is meant to unify the services under a federal framework as digital-asset adoption expands.

Per the company, the request joins more than 50 licenses it holds in the US, Europe and Asia, including broker-dealer and swap-dealer registrations in the US, a license in Britain and recently also digital-asset and money-transmission licenses in New York. The meaning at this stage is an attempt to expand the regulatory framework, not an approval already received or a start of the bank's activity.

Source: Galaxy Digital's announcement (PRNewswire)

כותרת_en: HIVE Digital (HIVE) signed a loan agreement of about $129 million at a fixed rate for compute for Cohere

Oct 27, 2026 | the publication time is unknown

The item was sent after the publication.

HIVE Digital announced through its compute division (BUZZ HPC) signing a loan and security agreement with an institutional lender, in the scope of about $129 million, at a fixed rate of 9% for three years. This is signing an agreement, not confirmation the money was already transferred.

The financing is meant for a compute cluster in Canada for a three-year contract with Cohere, announced in June. The cluster includes NVIDIA systems (NVIDIA GB200 NVL72) and a total of 2,303 GB200-type GPU units. Per the company, the loan covers about 80% of the cost of a $165 million cluster; the total contract value with Cohere is $225 million and includes compute, connectivity and storage.

The loan is backed by the equipment and the contract, is meant to be repaid from the contract's revenue and includes no share issuance. Equipment delivery is expected toward the end of the fourth quarter of 2026. The agreement adds financing for expansion without an equity raise, but with a commitment to interest and debt repayment.

Oct 28, 2026 | 4:30 PM Israel time

The US Energy Information Administration (EIA) reported commercial crude-oil inventories, excluding the strategic reserve, fell 1.9 million barrels in the week ended October 23, to 410.6 million barrels. The decline is milder than the previous week's, which was about 3.1 million barrels.

In refined products the picture is mixed: gasoline inventories rose 3.9 million barrels, while distillate inventories, including diesel and heating fuel, fell 1.5 million barrels. זו הודעת תוצאות ראשוניות של החברה, לא פרסום מדעי מלא שעבר ביקורת עמיתים. רטטרוטייד עדיין ניסיונית ואינה מאושרת לשיווק. ההשוואה היא לאוזמפיק בסוכרת סוג 2, ולא לכל תרופות ההרזיה.

כותרת_en: Eli Lilly (LLY): positive results in a phase 3 trial of retatrutide versus Ozempic
טקסט_en:
The item was sent after the publication

Oct 28, 2026, 12:45 PM Israel time

Per the company's announcement, in a head-to-head trial of 1,298 adults with type 2 diabetes, the experimental retatrutide lowered glycated hemoglobin (A1C) by 2.2 percentage points, versus 1.8 percentage points on Ozempic at a 2 mg dose, after 80 weeks.

The average weight loss was 19.5% at the 9 mg dose and 20.9% at the 12 mg dose, versus 9.4% on Ozempic. The trial met the primary endpoint and all key secondary endpoints. These numbers are based on an analysis estimating the outcome had participants stayed on treatment throughout the period.

On the other hand, treatment discontinuation due to side effects was more common: 4.8% and 7.9% at the two retatrutide doses, versus 2.7% on Ozempic. Most side effects were gastrointestinal and mild to moderate in severity.

This is the company's preliminary results announcement, not a full peer-reviewed scientific publication. Retatrutide is still experimental and is not approved for marketing. The comparison is to Ozempic in type 2 diabetes, not to all weight-loss drugs.

Source: Eli Lilly

Oct 28, 2026, 10:13 AM Israel time - the article's update time

South Korea's media and communications regulator decided to impose a fine of 42.9 billion won on Google and 20.81 billion won on Apple. Together this is about 63.7 billion won, about $45 million per Yonhap. This is a final decision of the regulator, not the proposed fine published in 2023.

Per the report, the regulator determined the companies in practice limited the use of alternative payment systems, through fees and burdensome terms, contrary to local law. Alongside the fines, orders were given to allow alternative payment means, including links to external payment from within the app, and to adjust the fees on third-party payments to a reasonable level.

Google is required to change the rules for presenting payment options. Apple is required to cancel the requirement to submit a separate app in order to offer an alternative payment. The companies are required to submit compliance plans within a month of receiving the orders and to implement the changes within three months.

For an investor, the part worth following beyond the fine is the change in billing and fee terms in South Korea. The decision is not in itself a global change to the stores' rules, and no quantitative estimate of harm to the companies' revenue was published in the report. Google expressed regret over the decision and argued policy changes it presented in March were not reflected in it.

קשור לפריט שנשלח ב־26.10 ב־07:37 על הרישום הזמני של זרוע הסליקה של סיבו.
מה חדש: תוכנית נפרדת של בורסת ניו יורק למסחר באופציות בינאריות על ניירות ערך, לצד שינוי כללים שכבר נכנס לתוקף. המסחר עצמו עדיין לא החל לפי הדיווח.

לפי רויטרס, בכיר בבורסת ניו יורק אמר שהמסחר צפוי להתחיל בתוך ימים ב־12 ניירות, ובהם אפל, אנבידיה, טסלה ותעודת הסל על מדד אס־אנד־פי 500 (SPY). בהמשך מתוכננת הרחבת ההיצע.

האופציות האלה (ByRDs) נפרעות במזומן בתוצאה של הכל או לא כלום: חוזה מסוג "מעל" משלם 100 דולר אם מחיר הסגירה שווה למחיר המימוש או גבוה ממנו, ואפס אחרת; חוזה מסוג "מתחת" משלם 100 דולר אם הסגירה נמוכה ממחיר המימוש, ואפס אחרת. אלה 100 דולר לחוזה, לא דולר אחד לחוזה. הסכום הוא תשלום הפירעון, לא רווח מובטח: צריך להביא בחשבון את מחיר קניית האופציה והעמלות, ואפשר לאבד את מלוא הסכום ששולם.

לפי ההגשה הרשמית, מחיר הפירעון ייקבע לפי מחיר הסגירה בבורסה הראשית במקום ממוצע מחירים משוקלל לאורך היום. גם תנאי הזכאות לניירות הוחמרו. שינוי הכללים נכנס לתוקף עם ההגשה ב־21.10; הודעת הרשות פורסמה ב־27.10. זו השקה מחודשת במתכונת מעודכנת של מוצר ותיק, לא המצאה של סוג אופציה שלא היה קיים.

בנפרד, ההצעה של הבורסה לאופציות בינאריות על תוצאות עסקיות של חברות, כמו הכנסות או רווח למניה, עדיין ממתינה לאישור. אין לבלבל בינה לבין המסחר המתוכנן באופציות על מחיר המניה.

כותרת_en: NYSE (ICE) prepares for a relaunch of binary options on stocks and ETFs; trading expected to begin within days
טקסט_en:
Oct 27, 2026 - a Reuters report and the regulator's notice publication
*The publication time in Israel time is not verified*

Related to the item sent Oct 26 at 7:37 AM on the temporary registration of Cboe's clearing arm.
What is new: a separate New York Stock Exchange plan for trading binary options on securities, alongside a rule change that already took effect. Trading itself has not yet begun per the report.

Per Reuters, a senior NYSE official said trading is expected to begin within days in 12 securities, including Apple, NVIDIA, Tesla and the S&P 500 index ETF (SPY). A widening of the offering is planned later.

These options (ByRDs) settle in cash in an all-or-nothing outcome: an "above" contract pays $100 if the closing price equals or exceeds the strike price, and zero otherwise; a "below" contract pays $100 if the close is below the strike price, and zero otherwise. That is $100 per contract, not one dollar per contract. The amount is the settlement payment, not a guaranteed profit: the option's purchase price and fees must be taken into account, and the full amount paid can be lost.

Per the official filing, the settlement price will be set by the closing price on the primary exchange instead of a weighted average of prices through the day. The securities eligibility terms were also tightened. The rule change took effect with the filing on Oct 21; the regulator's notice was published Oct 27. This is a relaunch in an updated format of an old product, not the invention of an option type that did not exist.

Separately, the exchange's proposal for binary options on companies' business results, such as revenue or earnings per share, still awaits approval. It must not be confused with the planned trading in options on the share price.

Reuters, via Investing
The US Securities and Exchange Commission, the rule-change text

השוואת גרסאות שמורות של אתר אנבידיה מאשרת:
• רוחב פס הזיכרון לכל מעבד גרפי ירד מ־22 ל־19.2 טרה־בייט לשנייה, ירידה של כ־12.7%.
• רוחב פס הזיכרון במערכת של 72 מעבדים ירד מ־1,580 ל־1,400 טרה־בייט לשנייה.
• רוחב הפס הדו־כיווני של החיבור בין המעבדים (NVLink) ירד מ־3.6 ל־3.0 טרה־בייט לשנייה לכל מעבד.
• קיבולת הזיכרון לכל מעבד נותרה 288 גיגה־בייט. רוחב פס נמוך יותר אינו אומר שקיבולת הזיכרון קטנה.

התזמון חשוב: בגרסה השמורה מ־1.9 מופיע המפרט הישן, ובגרסה מ־11.9 כבר מופיע החדש. כלומר, השינוי באתר התרחש בין התאריכים האלה, ללא הודעה נפרדת. הדיווח הראשון שמצאתי פורסם ב־26.10, אך לא נכלל בעדכונים שנשלחו אז; הוא אותר ואומת רק הבוקר.

כותרת_en: NVIDIA (NVDA): a lowered Vera Rubin memory and connection specification was exposed; the website change was made already in September
טקסט_en:
Oct 26, 2026 - the first report on TechPowerUp; the publication time in Israel time is unknown
An additional Electronic Times report: Oct 28, 2026, with no published hour

Related to the item sent Oct 27 at 9:20 PM on Oracle's infrastructure expansion with Vera Rubin systems.
What is new: press reports expose that these systems' official specification is lower than the specification presented earlier. This is not a change NVIDIA announced this morning.

A comparison of saved versions of NVIDIA's website confirms:
- Memory bandwidth per GPU fell from 22 to 19.2 terabytes per second, a decline of about 12.7%.
- Memory bandwidth in a 72-processor system fell from 1,580 to 1,400 terabytes per second.
- The bidirectional bandwidth of the connection between processors (NVLink) fell from 3.6 to 3.0 terabytes per second per processor.
- Memory capacity per processor remained 288 gigabytes. Lower bandwidth does not say memory capacity shrank.

The timing matters: the saved version from Sep 1 shows the old specification, and the Sep 11 version already shows the new one. That is, the website change happened between those dates, with no separate announcement. The first report I found was published Oct 26, but was not included in the updates sent then; it was located and verified only this morning.

Per industry sources cited by Electronic Times, the reduction may ease manufacturing of the new-generation memory (HBM4) and the rate of good components in production. This is industry interpretation, not NVIDIA's official explanation. The data confirm lowered specification targets, but do not prove an identical decline in actual AI application performance.

27.10.2026, 22:23 שעון ישראל: מועד קבלת הדיווח ברשות ניירות הערך האמריקאית. ההסדר מתוארך ל־26.10.

בדיווח רשמי מסרה ברודקום ששותפים פיננסיים נטלו חלק מהסכמי הרכישה של ארונות שרתים המבוססים על המאיצים הייעודיים שלה, ומהסכמי ההשכרה הקשורים ללקוח. ברודקום מספקת לישות ייעודית גיבוי לערך השיורי של הציוד. אם הלקוח יפר את חובות השכירות שלו, ברודקום עלולה לשאת בהתחייבות כלפי גוף המימון.

לפי החברה, החשיפה המקסימלית האפשרית לאחר פריסת הארונות היא כ־43 מיליארד דולר, ללא היוון. החבות האפשרית מחושבת כהפרש בין 72.5% מהסכומים שנותרו לתשלום בחכירה לבין שווי הארונות שיתקבל ממכירתם. היקף הגיבוי עולה עם המסירות והפריסה, ויורד כשהלקוח משלם את דמי השכירות.

ברודקום מציינת אפשרויות לצמצום החשיפה במקרה של חדלות פירעון: נטילת החכירה, מכירת הציוד בחזרה למוכר במחיר קבוע בתנאים מסוימים, או מכירתו לצד אחר. החברה מעריכה שסבירות מימוש ההתחייבות נמוכה, בהתבסס על הצפי לרווחיות הלקוח ולשימור ערך הנכסים. זו הערכת החברה, לא ביטול הסיכון, וגם לא הוצאה של 43 מיליארד דולר שכבר נרשמה.

שם הלקוח אינו מופיע בדיווח. אין בו אישור רשמי שמדובר באנתרופיק.

קשור לפריט שנשלח ב־27.10 ב־16:41 על ברודקום והדיווח בג'ורנל, ובהמשך לפריט מ־10:37 על מבנה המימון. מה חדש: הכימות הרשמי של החשיפה המותנית והנוסחה לחישובה, מעבר למנגנון המימון שתואר קודם.

הפריט נשלח באיחור מהפרסום.

כותרת_en: Broadcom (AVGO): maximum conditional exposure of about $43 billion in backing for AI server-rack financing
טקסט_en:
Oct 27, 2026, 10:23 PM Israel time: the filing's receipt time at the US Securities and Exchange Commission. The arrangement is dated Oct 26.

In an official filing Broadcom said financial partners took part of the purchase agreements for server racks based on its dedicated accelerators, and of the related customer lease agreements. Broadcom provides a special-purpose entity with backing for the equipment's residual value. If the customer breaches its lease obligations, Broadcom may bear the commitment toward the financing party.

Per the company, the maximum possible exposure after the racks are deployed is about $43 billion, undiscounted. The possible liability is calculated as the difference between 72.5% of the amounts remaining to be paid under the lease and the racks' value that would be received from selling them. The backing's scope rises with deliveries and deployment, and falls as the customer pays the lease fees.

Broadcom notes options for reducing the exposure in case of default: taking over the lease, selling the equipment back to the seller at a fixed price under certain conditions, or selling it to another party. The company estimates the likelihood of the commitment being realized is low, based on the customer's expected profitability and the assets' value retention. This is the company's estimate, not a removal of the risk, and also not a $43 billion expense already recorded.

The customer's name does not appear in the filing. It contains no official confirmation that this is Anthropic.

Related to the item sent Oct 27 at 4:41 PM on Broadcom and the Journal report, and following it to the 10:37 AM item on the financing structure. What is new: the official quantification of the conditional exposure and the formula for calculating it, beyond the financing mechanism described earlier.

The item was sent after the publication.

Primary source: Broadcom's filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission

כותרת: תחקיר אי־פי: נתוני לוויינים ועדויות מצביעים על סיוע מודיעיני רוסי לתקיפות בסעודיה

בנפרד מהניתוח הלווייני, גורמים שצוטטו בתחקיר טענו שהחות'ים ובעלות ברית של איראן נהנו ממודיעין רוסי ומיכולות סיניות. בכיר סעודי התייחס בפומבי לסיוע מגורמים ברוסיה ובסין. התחקיר מתאר גם פגיעה במטוס קרב איטלקי בבסיס בטאיף, לפי משרד ההגנה האיטלקי, ותקיפה של תחנות שאיבה בצינור הנפט מזרח־מערב.

ההסתייגות חשובה: חברת המודיעין לא יירטה העברה של מידע בפועל. התאמה בין מעברי לוויינים לתקיפות אינה כשלעצמה הוכחה להעברת מודיעין או לתיאום רוסי. רוסיה לא הגיבה לטענות בעת הדיווח.

כותרת_en: AP investigation: satellite data and testimonies point to Russian intelligence assistance for attacks in Saudi Arabia
טקסט_en:
*The intelligence-assistance claims are not independently verified against a primary source*
Oct 27, 2026, 5:11 PM Israel time: the update time shown on AP. *The first publication time is unknown*

Per an Associated Press investigation, a Geneva-based geospatial-intelligence company examined 40 attacks by the Houthis and Iraqi militias against targets in Saudi Arabia between Jul 1 and Oct 19. The company found a match between Russian spy-satellite activity and the attacks' timing. Around two of the targets, per the analysis, an increase of about 50% was recorded in the number of Russian satellites in a 72-hour window around the attacks, compared with July.

Separate from the satellite analysis, sources quoted in the investigation claimed the Houthis and Iran's allies benefited from Russian intelligence and Chinese capabilities. A senior Saudi official publicly referred to assistance from parties in Russia and China. The investigation also describes a hit on an Italian fighter jet at a base in Taif, per the Italian Defense Ministry, and an attack on pumping stations on the East-West oil pipeline.

The reservation matters: the intelligence company did not intercept an actual transfer of information. A match between satellite passes and attacks is not in itself proof of intelligence transfer or Russian coordination. Russia did not respond to the claims at the time of the report.

Related to the item sent Oct 28 at 1:22 AM on the American departure order from Saudi Arabia, and to the coverage of the attacks on the kingdom's infrastructure. What is new: the findings and testimonies about possible intelligence involvement of additional parties, not a new overnight attack.

The item was sent after the publication. The full content was checked on an AP copy published in syndication.

טקסט:
27.10.2026, *שעת הפרסום אינה ידועה במקורות הראשוניים*

אפל הכריזה על מקבוק פרו בגודל 14 אינץ' ועל איימק עם השבב החדש. המחירים בארה"ב מתחילים ב־1,999 דולר למקבוק פרו וב־1,499 דולר לאיימק. ההזמנות המוקדמות ייפתחו ב־28.10 ב־35 מדינות ואזורים, והמסירות והזמינות בחנויות יתחילו ב־6.11. זו אינה הודעה על מחיר או זמינות בישראל.

לפי בדיקות אפל, המעבד הגרפי בעל 12 הליבות במקבוק פרו מציע ביצועים גרפיים מהירים בעד 30% ועומסי בינה מלאכותית מהירים בעד 25% לעומת הדור הקודם (M5). החברה מציינת חיי סוללה של עד 24 שעות. באיימק היא טוענת לביצועי בינה מלאכותית מקומיים מהירים עד פי חמישה לעומת הדגם עם שבב הדור הרביעי (M4). אלו טענות ביצועים של היצרנית, לא תוצאות בדיקה עצמאית.

בנפרד, לפי רויטרס, אפל תקיים ב־28.10 אירוע בלוס אנג'לס. רויטרס מצטטת דיווח של בלומברג שלפיו צפוי בו מקבוק פרו ראשון עם מסך מגע. *הצפי למסך מגע לא מאומת מול הודעה רשמית של אפל*, ואינו חלק מההכרזה המאושרת לעיל.

הפריט נשלח באיחור מהפרסום; ההכרזות הן מ־27.10.

כותרת: AMD (AMD) ו-Anthropic: צפי הוצאה של מעל 20 מיליארד דולר על קיבולת מחשוב במערכות הליוס
טקסט:
26.10.2026, *שעת הגשת התשקיף אינה ידועה*

אותו תשקיף חושף גם את היקף ההסכם עם איי־אם־די מיולי: אנתרופיק התחייבה לקבל נתח ראשוני של קיבולת מחשוב בשנת 2027, באמצעות רכישת מערכות הליוס מבוססות איי־אם־די מיצרנים מאושרים, או באמצעות גישה אליהן דרך ספקיות צד שלישי, בכפוף לתנאים הקשורים להצעות הפריסה.

בהסכם אין סכום דולרי קבוע. אנתרופיק מעריכה שאם תרכוש את מלוא הקיבולת הראשונית, ההוצאה המצטברת לאורך ההסכם תעלה על 20 מיליארד דולר. הסכום אינו כלול בטבלת ההתחייבויות החוזיות בתשקיף. קיימת גם אפשרות לקיבולת נוספת בהיקף דומה בקירוב לנתח הראשוני.

בשונה מהסכמי ספייס־אקס לאחר תקופותיהם הראשוניות, אנתרופיק אינה רשאית לבטל את הסכם איי־אם־די, למעט הפרה מהותית מצד איי־אם־די שלא תוקנה. לכן צריך להבחין בין היעדר סכום חוזי קבוע לבין אפשרות לבטל את ההסכם.

קשור לפריט שנשלח ב־27.10 ב־16:09 על מערכות הליוס בשותפות איי־אם־די ומטא. מה חדש: כימות ההוצאה הצפויה של אנתרופיק במסגרת ההסכם שלה, לא עסקה חדשה שנחתמה הלילה.

כותרת: AMD (AMD) ו-Meta (META) מרחיבות שותפות: מערכות הליוס כבר אצל Meta (META), ושבבים מותאמים בדרך
טקסט:
פורסם במקור: 27.10.2026, 15:20 שעון ישראל
בהודעה רשמית מסרה איי־אם־די שמערכות הליוס (Helios) הותקנו אצל מטא ונמצאות בבדיקות לקראת פריסה רחבה. חשוב להבדיל: ההתקנה כבר בוצעה, אך הפריסה הרחבה עדיין לא הושלמה.

מעבדי החברה (EPYC) מפעילים את סביבות המחשוב שמאחורי סוכן הבינה המלאכותית של מטא (Muse). מטא, שכבר פרסה מיליוני מעבדים מהסדרה, היא לקוחת דגל של הדור השישי ומשתפת פעולה גם בפיתוח הדור הבא (Verano).

במאיצי הבינה המלאכותית, מטא כבר משתמשת בשבבי החברה (Instinct) לאימון ולדירוג בסביבת ייצור. היא הייתה שותפה מוקדמת בהגדרת הארכיטקטורה (MI450), ובהמשך תפרוס שבב מותאם לעומסי העבודה שלה. שיתוף הפעולה ישפיע גם על הדור הבא (MI500) ועל מערכות מחשוב ברמת ארון שלם.

קשור לפריט שנשלח ב־27.10 ב־11:42 על השקעה מוצעת של אנבידיה במטא ותשתיות הבינה המלאכותית שלה.
מה חדש: כאן מדובר בהודעת חומרה רשמית של איי־אם־די, כולל התקנה ובדיקות שכבר החלו ותכנון שבבים מותאמים, ולא בהצעת השקעה במניות.

הודעת איי־אם־די הרשמית
כותרת_en: AMD (AMD) and Meta (META) expand the partnership: Helios systems already at Meta (META), and customized chips on the way
טקסט_en:
Published in the source: Oct 27, 2026, 3:20 PM Israel time
In an official announcement AMD said Helios systems were installed at Meta and are in testing ahead of broad deployment. It is important to distinguish: the installation was already done, but the broad deployment is not yet complete.

The company's processors (EPYC) power the compute environments behind Meta's AI agent (Muse). Meta, which has already deployed millions of processors from the series, is a flagship customer of the sixth generation and also cooperates in developing the next generation (Verano).

In AI accelerators, Meta already uses the company's chips (Instinct) for training and ranking in a production environment. It was an early partner in defining the architecture (MI450), and will later deploy a chip customized to its workloads. The cooperation will also affect the next generation (MI500) and full-rack-level compute systems.

Related to the item sent Oct 27 at 11:42 AM on NVIDIA's proposed investment in Meta and its AI infrastructure.
What is new: here this is AMD's official hardware announcement, including installation and tests already underway and customized-chip planning, not a proposed share investment.

לפי הודעת התמחור הרשמית, ההנפקה של המניות הרגילות, בקשר להסכמי מכירה עתידית, תומחרה ב־625 דולר למניה ובהיקף 25 מיליארד דולר. בנוסף תומחרו 250 מיליון יחידות המייצגות מניות בכורה להמרה חובה, ב־50 דולר ליחידה: היקף של 12.5 מיליארד דולר. יחד: 37.5 מיליארד דולר שתומחרו, לא סכום שכבר התקבל כולו במזומן.

Together: $37.5 billion priced, not an amount already received in full in cash.

• כ־22.5 מיליארד דולר במניות מסוג A, במבנה מכירה עתידית. מטא לא מקבלת את התמורה בתחילת העסקה; קבלתה תלויה בסילוק ההסכמים בהמשך, עד נובמבר 2027.
• כ־12.5 מיליארד דולר באמצעות מניות פיקדון המייצגות מניות בכורה עם המרה מחייבת למניות רגילות בהמשך.

ההנפקות טרם תומחרו או הושלמו. לכן זו אינה הודעה שמטא כבר גייסה 35 מיליארד דולר במזומן.

What is new: per Meta's announcement and the preliminary prospectus, the company launched two offerings in parallel to finance AI investments:

- About $22.5 billion in Class A shares, in a forward-sale structure. Meta does not receive the proceeds at the start of the deal; receiving them depends on settling the agreements later, through November 2027.
- About $12.5 billion through depositary shares representing preferred shares with mandatory conversion into common shares later.

Per the announcement, no agreement has yet been signed for the program and its final terms have not been set. There is no completed raise of $95 billion here.

For you as a shareholder: this is a new equity offering, separate from the Class C share distribution to existing shareholders. The actual dilution rate cannot be determined from the amounts alone, before the pricing, conversion and execution terms.

טקסט:

החברות צופות סינרגיות שנתיות של כ־325 מיליון דולר בתוך שנתיים, עם אפשרות להרחבתן בהמשך. אלו תחזיות, לא חיסכון שכבר הושג.

כותרת_en: A merger in the gas industry: EQT (EQT) signed an agreement to acquire Range Resources in a share deal
טקסט_en:
The companies announced an agreement under which each Range Resources share will be converted into 0.987 shares of the acquirer. After the deal's completion, the acquirer's shareholders are expected to hold about 73% of the combined company, and Range shareholders about 27%.

Per the companies, the merger will create the largest natural-gas producer in the US, with a combined enterprise value of more than $50 billion. This is the combined company's value, not Range's purchase price. The announcement did not state a separate consideration value for Range shares.

The companies expect annual synergies of about $325 million within two years, with an option to expand them later. These are forecasts, not savings already achieved.

The deal is not yet complete. The closing is planned for the first quarter of 2027, subject to regulatory and both companies' shareholder approvals.

טקסט_en:
Related to the item sent Oct 25 at 12:22 PM on the declines on the Saudi exchange against the background of the escalation with the Houthis.

כותרת: SpaceX (SPCX): דיווח רשמי מבהיר את מימון השבבים - התחייבות לשכירות מימון עם אפולו, לא 40 מיליארד דולר שכבר התקבלו
